data: 一些恐鱼遵循着潮起潮落的规律活动，有心的猎人便以此为突破口消灭恐鱼。
恐魚の中には、潮の規則的な満ち引きに忠実に従うものもいる。ハンターはこれを突破口として恐魚を殲滅せんと目論んだ。
Some Sea Terrors have behaviors that match the regularity of the tide's ebb and flow. Observant Hunters use this as an opportunity to go forth and eliminate them.
所有敌方单位的攻击力，防御力+30%，生命值，移动速度+50%
敵全員の攻撃力、防御力+30%、最大HP、移動速度+50%
All enemy units have +30% ATK, +30% DEF, +50% Max HP and +50% Movement speed
The next attack deals <@ba.vup>200%</> ATK as Physical damage and pushes the enemy away with great force
Reflect some damage taken, gives +4 Originium Ingots when defeated
